items.title: Walmart (WMT) Q3 Results Meet Sales Growth But Profitability Cools
items.summary: Walmart came into this earnings print priced for near perfection, trading on a rich P/E multiple and sitting on a roughly 23.5% gain over the past three months. Q3 FY27 results did not break the story on the top line, with revenue of US$188.8b, but the real tension sits in profitability. Net income from ongoing operations landed at US$4.9b and basic EPS was US$0.62, softer than the prior quarter, even as the stock jumped 1.6% on the day. The market cheered.
